messages:
jane_sales: Hey team — Acme POC demo at 2pm, their integration is intermittently getting 429s during a bulk-embed run. Demo is in ~3 hours, can someone triage? :eyes:
ryan_sales: We enabled more concurrent clients for them this morning. Any error text?
alex_eng: Looking now, can you paste a sample request id / timestamp?
jane_sales: sample req id  -> `req_abc123` (2024-05-04T10:12:34Z). Payload is a batch of 64 texts for embeddings (each ~450 tokens). Using our hosted API with their API key.
samantha_support: Got it, pulling logs for that req id. Can you also paste the curl you used?
jane_sales: curl snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-01" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite-1","inputs":["...", "..."]}'
```
alex_eng: Log excerpt for req_abc123:
```
[2024-05-04T10:12:34Z] req=req_abc123 user=acme key=sk-acme-01 status=429 reason=rate_limit_per_route per_route_cap=60/60 concurrent=24 token_usage=28800
X-RateLimit-Reset: 2024-05-04T10:13:10Z
```
mike_infra: Looks like they're hitting the per-route cap (60 reqs/min) because they're sending many concurrent batch requests. Token budget also high because batch size * embeddings length.
ryan_sales: They thought "concurrency=100" would be fine for demo traffic.
samantha_support: Quick mitigations: 1) reduce batch concurrency client-side to <= 10, 2) drop batch size from 64 -> 16 for demo, or 3) request a short-lived per-route bump from sales ops.
alex_eng: Also recommend enabling prefix/KV caching for their workflow if they reuse inputs — will cut token work. For immediate triage, set client to exponential backoff on 429s with jitter.
jane_sales: Can we do a temporary bump for the 2pm slot? They want a smooth demo.
mike_infra: We can approve a short-lived per-route increase (to 180/min) for 3 hours. Need ticket with account id and exact window. @ryan_sales can you file request in /ops-quotas with acct acme-001 and window 2024-05-04T13:45 to 2024-05-04T16:45?
ryan_sales: Filing now. ETA approval ~10m. :hourglass_flowing_sand: ticket #Q-5421 created.
ratebot: [system] Rate-limit event tracked: acct=acme-001 bumped?=no peak=72rpm
samantha_support: If bump approved, also add a per-route fallback to a cheaper embed model to avoid overflow.
jane_sales: Thanks team — I'll ask Acme to reduce concurrency and enable backoff while we wait on the ticket. Will update in 10m. :thumbsup:
